defs.def: a small container shaped like a bowl, usually with a handle, used for drinking tea, coffee, etc. 杯子

ex.s: After finishing an order, she calls out the name on the cup.
ex.t: 完成一单后，她会喊出杯子上写的名字。

ex.s: Place your cup in the deepest part of the hole.
The low point of the sheet must be centered directly over, and no more than three inches above, the cup.
ex.t: 塑料布的最低点必须正好对准杯子中心，且高出杯子不超过三英寸。

ex.s: When a solar still works, drops of water come into the cup form          .
ex.t: 当太阳能蒸馏器工作时，水滴会汇集到杯子里。

ex.s: Then lay the tube in place so that one end rests all the way in the cup and the rest of the line runs up — and out — the side of the hole.
ex.t: 然后把管子放好，使一端一直伸到杯子里，管子的其余部分沿着孔的一侧向上——并伸出——孔外。

defs.def: the contents of a cup 一杯（的量）

ex.s: To me, there's nothing better than a cross-cultural afternoon tea of English biscuits and a cup of Chinese oolong tea in a fine china cup!
ex.t: 对我来说，没有什么比一杯英式饼干的跨文化下午茶和一杯精致的瓷杯中的中国乌龙茶更好的了！

ex.s: The Diary of a Young Girl WEDNESDAY, 3 MAY 1944 Dearest Kitty, For the last two weeks we’ve been eating lunch at eleven-thirty on Saturdays; in the mornings we have to make do with a cup of cereal.
ex.t: 《一个年轻女孩的日记》：1944年5月3日，星期三。最亲爱的凯蒂，最近两个星期六我们都在十一点半吃午饭；早上我们只能凑合着喝一杯麦片粥。

defs.def: a unit for measuring quantity used in cooking in the US; a metal or plastic container used to measure this quantity 杯（美国用作烹饪的计量单位）；量杯（金属或塑料量器）

ex.s: Minutes after the last movie ended yesterday at the Plaza Theater, employees were busy sweeping up popcorns and gathering coke cups.
ex.t: 昨天，广场影院最后一场电影结束后几分钟，员工们就开始忙着清扫爆米花和收集可乐杯。

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 不过唯一需要的部件是一张5×5英尺的透明或微乳白塑料布、六英尺塑料管，以及一个容器——或许就一个喝水杯——来接水。

ex.s: But does one plastic straw or cup really make a difference?
ex.t: 但一根塑料吸管或一个塑料杯真的有影响吗？

ex.s: When the Chinese team was preparing for the 2015 World Cup, her determination was tested.
ex.t: 当中国队备战2015年世界杯时，她的决心受到了考验。

defs.def: a thing shaped like a cup 杯状物
a gold or silver cup on a stem, often with two handles, that is given as a prize in a competition 奖杯；优胜杯
a sports competition in which a cup is given as a prize 优胜杯赛
one of the two parts of a bra that cover the breast （胸罩的）罩杯
a drink made from wine mixed with, for example, fruit juice （由葡萄酒与果汁等调制的）混合饮料
a hollow in the ground that you must get the ball into 高尔夫球
a piece of plastic that a man wears over his sex organs to protect them while he is playing a sport （体育运动时保护男子生殖器的）护杯；下身保护罩

ex.s: Pele played professionally in Brazil for two decades, winning three World Cups along the way, and is considered to be one of the greatest football players.
ex.t: 贝利在巴西职业足坛效力了二十年，期间赢得了三届世界杯，被认为是最伟大的足球运动员之一。

defs.def: to make your hands into the shape of a bowl 使（手）窝成杯状

ex.s: With the bird in my cupped hand, I looked around to see how she had gotten in.
ex.t: 手托着这只鸟，我环顾四周看她是怎么进来的。

defs.def: to hold sth, making your hands into a round shape 使（双手）成圆状托起
